findings.description: storage_encrypted is set to false, so the RDS database stores data unencrypted at rest on the underlying storage, exposing sensitive data if the storage is compromised.
publicly_accessible is set to true and the instance is placed in a public subnet, exposing the MySQL database directly to the internet.
The aws_security_group_rule egress rule allows all outbound traffic to 0.0.0.0/0 with protocol '-1', providing a potential data exfiltration path and channel to command-and-control infrastructure.
The EC2 role policy grants wildcard actions (s3:*, ec2:*, rds:*) on Resource '*' for the EC2 instance profile, which is effectively administrative access and far exceeds least privilege.
The RDS database password (var.password) is embedded in plain text in the EC2 instance user_data startup script, making it readable by anyone with describe permissions on the instance.
skip_final_snapshot is set to true and deletion protection is not enabled, meaning an accidental or malicious deletion of the database will permanently destroy all data with no recovery path.
